verdict.rationale: BVNK documents creating crypto and fiat wallets through the API, either for a specific customer (by passing a customer ID and reference) or for its own account. It also documents deposit addresses: reusable "channel" blockchain addresses and a unique address generated per payment. Nothing in the pack describes key custody semantics, i.e. who holds the private keys or whether wallets are custodial or segregated, and that is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: documented key custody semantics, explicit API endpoint/reference for wallet creation, per-purpose wallet labeling detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
